name: The recall memory with context in the key, progress hidden (A, B, A, B): recall_context 0.5 and 1.0 against the founder and the plain recall recipe
credit: Will Glynn, cadence-teachers EXP-56, EXP-57, EXP-59 and EXP-60 (https://github.com/WGlynn/cadence-teachers): the chain seen three ways after the ambiguous chain Huncho reported on the Stone Age world, the hold rule, the reading in sequence, the boundary of the rule; the consecutive-alias topology is Huncho's Stone Age V7.4 (https://github.com/ali12mahmood12345-boop/cadence-stone-age/blob/main/docs/V7_RESULTS.md)
question: With Brain.compose(7, 5, modules=(48, 24), arousal=True, memory_choice=True, recall=True): when a moment's key and address carry the fading history of the events before it (recall_context 0.5 or 1.0, recall_context_decay 0.5), do the place and ctx5 arms keep their sampled success and clean greedy passes against the founder, and on which views does context raise them over the plain recall recipe?
scope: component witness of the recall memory's context setting in a world: the chain seen three ways (hidden, invisible, visible), the two screen founders of the first reading; a follow-up of protocol-recall-screen.json, a witness, not a gate

world.note: A, B, A, B: the ambiguous chain Huncho reported on the Stone Age world, as cadence-teachers EXP-56 and EXP-57 rebuilt it; the two A and the two B observations are byte-identical, so only the stream's history tells stage 3 from stage 1

founder.note: Brain.compose(7, 5, modules=(48, 24), arousal=True, memory_choice=True): the context-key screen's sensory recipe with the recall memory off (recall=False, byte-identical to the brain before the option); retained from the first reading's runs (rs-<view>, protocol-recall-screen-<view>.json), not rerun

recall.note: the first reading's recall recipe (recall_context 0.0); retained from its runs (rs-<view>), not rerun

recall_ctx05.note: the recall recipe plus recall_context=0.5, recall_context_decay=0.5: a moment's key and address are the event heard plus half of the fading history of the events before it (history = 0.5 * history + event after each witnessed moment); the same wiring and initial weights

recall_ctx10.note: the same with recall_context=1.0: the history weighs as much as the event in the key and the address

schedule.unit: executed decisions of the whole life

caregiver.label: natural: none; corrective: the required action of the observation shown now, after an executed nonterminal mistake in a guided window (V5's corrective teacher)

evaluation.note: a frozen copy read at the arm's seam under its own rule, Brain.reset before each episode (the recall slots emptied, the address map kept): 100 sampled episodes, the reading in sequence (first try per stage, retries), and one greedy episode (a clean pass: four stages in four decisions)

seeds.note: the first reading's two founders; the two context recipes on each (--recipes recall_ctx05 recall_ctx10), the founder and recall rows retained from the first reading

analysis.unit: founder and signal; a pair is one arm on one founder under one signal, each recipe against the founder recipe
analysis.pairs_per_view: two founders x two signals x two arm kinds: 8 pairs per view, 4 per arm kind
analysis.readings: per view, recipe, arm and founder: sampled success (100 episodes) and the clean greedy pass (one greedy episode, four stages in four decisions); first-try accuracy per stage beside them; for the hidden view the stage-3 first-try accuracy per recipe, arm and founder
analysis.preservation: per view and context recipe, the recipe minus the founder in sampled success, the paired mean over the 8 pairs, at or above -.05; reported beside the plain recall recipe's
analysis.benefit: per view, the context recipes whose paired mean against the founder is above zero, and whether each exceeds the plain recall recipe's paired mean on that view
analysis.better_recipe: the context recipe with the higher mean paired difference against the founder in sampled success over the three views' 24 pairs; a tie goes to the one with more clean passes; declared before the run as the recipe P1 runs on
analysis.report: paired means with their SEM over the 8 pairs and per arm kind over 4; no interval is claimed on two founders; the retained founder and recall rows are the first reading's; each recipe's place against ctx5 as the screen reported it

derived_from.note: written by recall_screen.py derive; the master declares every view
